turns.speaker: yoyo
turns.text: Riri, look! I found a tiny seed beside the classroom window.

turns.speaker: riri
turns.text: Oh! Do you think it could grow into a flower?

turns.speaker: yoyo
turns.text: Maybe. Let's give it some soil, water, and a sunny place.

turns.speaker: riri
turns.text: I'll pour slowly, so the little seed doesn't wash away.

turns.speaker: yoyo
turns.text: Good idea. We can check it every morning.

turns.speaker: riri
turns.text: And when it sprouts, we'll draw its first green leaf!

turns.speaker: yoyo
turns.text: Deal. Our classroom has a new little friend.

turns.speaker: riri
turns.text: Welcome, tiny seed. We'll help you grow!
